title: Lion cub holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <line x1='74' y1='44' x2='66' y2='62' stroke='#f7e08a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='32' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='32' rx='13' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#ff9db1' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='26' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#ffd0da'/>
  <polygon points='74,46 78,46 76,50' fill='#ff9db1'/>
  <!-- lion body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='74' rx='19' ry='14' fill='#f2b544'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#f2b544'/>
  <rect x='48' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#e39f2c'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='7' height='14' rx='3.5' fill='#f2b544' transform='rotate(-25 61 69)'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='24' fill='#d97a1e'/>
  <!-- mane inner shading -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='21' fill='#e88f2b'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='47' r='15' fill='#f8c95c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='35' r='5' fill='#f2b544'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='35' r='5' fill='#e39f2c'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='35' r='2.6' fill='#ffd88a'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='35' r='2.6' fill='#ffd88a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='45' r='2.6' fill='#5a3410'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='45' r='2.6' fill='#5a3410'/>
  <circle cx='36.9' cy='44' r='0.9' fill='#fff6da'/>
  <circle cx='48.9' cy='44' r='0.9' fill='#fff6da'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='53' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#ffeec2'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='39,50 45,50 42,53' fill='#c96a2a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M42 53.5 Q42 56 38.5 56 M42 53.5 Q42 56 45.5 56' stroke='#c96a2a' stroke-width='1.1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='51' r='2.5' fill='#f79a8f'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='51' r='2.5' fill='#f79a8f'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 78 Q14 76 16 66' stroke='#e39f2c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='64' r='4' fill='#d97a1e'/>
</svg>
